scope: fresh isolated local PetDex Codex Hook wrapper forwarding, lifecycle, configuration, and termination recheck

wrapper_contract.payload_forwarding: complete and chunked JSON payloads are forwarded without truncation
wrapper_contract.idle_input_close: native stdin closes after a bounded quiet interval
wrapper_contract.termination_fallback: SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL after a 200ms grace period

hook_configuration.missing_wrapper_behavior: each event returns explicit 127 instead of silently succeeding

upstream_boundary.issue_689: open; upstream native EOF behavior remains unresolved
upstream_boundary.draft_pr_710: open draft; unrelated to the EOF fix

result: The local wrapper forwards complete and 131115-byte chunked payloads, closes native stdin after bounded inactivity, preserves successful native exits, returns 127 for spawn or configuration failures, and reports deadline termination as 124 after SIGTERM/SIGKILL fallback. Hook configuration never falls back to the known EOF-prone native runner. This is local mitigation evidence and does not claim an upstream fix.
